0022600124.text: The Thunder (2-0, 1st in the Northwest and 3rd in the West) host the Suns (1-1, 2nd in the Pacific and 1.5 games back, 9th in the West) in Oklahoma City's fourth game of the season, with a 2-0 record, a 1-0 home mark, and a two-game winning streak. Oklahoma City is without Nikola Topic (out, back surgery), Otega Oweh (out, Achilles surgery), and Thomas Sorber (out, knee surgery), and Cason Wallace (shoulder) and Jaylin Williams (wrist soreness) are listed as day-to-day. Phoenix is missing Mark Williams (out, shoulder surgery), and Oso Ighodaro is day-to-day with an oblique strain. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Thunder won the 2025-26 regular-season series 3-2 and the 2025-26 playoff series 4-0, most recently a 131-122 win in Phoenix on April 27, 2026.
